_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Critical Defect Investigation Report
summary: This DID specifies the format and content for a report documenting the investigation of a critical defect, its root cause, segregated material, corrective action, and request for restart authority.
use_relationship:
The report documenting the investigation results of a critical defect identifies the occurrence(s) of critical defects and their root cause, segregated suspect material, planned corrective action, and the request for authority to restart.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Safety Report shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include a narrative description of the detailed investigation and analysis of the critical defect and shall include:

children.title: The root cause of the defect.
Evidence that the segregated material is not affected.
Corrective action(s) taken to eliminate the defect in remaining material and to preclude recurrence.
Any detailed diagrams, drawings, sketches, photographs, etc. needed to provide clarification on identification of items, parts, assemblies, and materials.
Segregated Material Use and Restart Request:
Reference to the approved notification, detail investigation and corrective action(s).
Identity of the material, lot number, and quantity.

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in Adobe electronic Portable Document Format (pdf), version 2007-2010.
